subject.title: fix(tavily): forward the execution abort signal to web search HTTP requests

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 own the shared `runWebSearch` parent-cancellation fallback change, leaving this PR to carry only Tavily-specific propagation?
rationale: Both branches implement the same shared-runtime invariant, but the SearXNG branch currently has positive real held-request proof; a maintainer must choose one canonical owner to avoid duplicate conflict resolution and future drift.

options.title: Use SearXNG as canonical
options.body: Land the shared runtime behavior through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 and rebase this PR to its Tavily-specific propagation and tests.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Keep the shared runtime hunk here only after equivalent real held-request and no-fallback proof is added and sibling branches are coordinated around it.

recommendation.title: Use SearXNG as canonical
recommendation.body: Land the shared runtime behavior through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 and rebase this PR to its Tavily-specific propagation and tests.
